title: "Tianji Fragment · New Mystery Emerges"
next_chapter_hook: "The cold warning of the Tianji Record echoed by his ear—the two-month countdown had already begun."

text.content: "The night wind passed through the broken window of the Servants' Quarters, bringing a cold chill. Chen Ji sat on the creaking wooden bed, fingers stroking the letter left by Ye Qing. Who was that 'person' in the mouth of the Demonic Path's Saint? His brow furrowed slightly, the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest burning faintly, as if responding to the unease in his heart. The candle flame flickered, casting his thin shadow onto the cracked earthen wall, now bright, now dim."

"Just then, the burning sensation in his chest suddenly intensified. Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly, and he quickly took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. On the yellowed page, the originally blurry outline of the third page was becoming clearer at a visible speed, golden lines spreading like a spider's web, as if something was awakening from slumber. Master Mo's remnant soul had said that when the threads of karma gathered to a certain critical point, the fragment would reveal itself."

"'This is...' Chen Ji's pupils constricted. In the blazing golden light, the third page fully formed, displaying a complete karma network diagram—each node representing an event, each connecting line marking the karmic relationship and time span. And in the center of the diagram, a line of tiny characters was赫然 inscribed: Karma Traceback, Against the Current, Cost—Thirty Percent of Heavenly Fate."

dialogue.content: "'Karma traceback...' Chen Ji murmured, his fingertip tracing lightly across the page. Compared to the foggy glimpsing of the future, this was clearly a far more domineering ability—it could allow one to trace the complete karma chain of any event, knowing every detail and participant within."

text.content: "However, when his finger touched that line of cost notation, the Tianji Record shook violently. An indescribable pressure came from all directions, as if countless eyes were opening in the void, gazing at him coldly. That was the will of the Heavenly Dao—Chen Ji was all too familiar with this sensation; whenever the Tianji Record attempted to peer into secrets it should not know, that gaze would arrive as expected."

dialogue.content: "'Kid, you're quite greedy.' Master Mo's voice rose幽幽 from the depths of the page, carrying a hint of mockery, 'Karma traceback is different from foresight—that's directly meddling with karma. Every time you use it, the Heavenly Dao's suppression on you grows stronger. The original three-month countdown... now is probably only two months left.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart tightened. Three months—that was the final deadline he had set for himself, when the inevitable backlash of fate would utterly devour him if he couldn't break the shackles of the Tianji Record. Now the deadline was shortened by one-third, which meant he had to accelerate his plans, or the abyss of utter destruction awaited him."

dialogue.content: "'However, you might want to look at this first.' Master Mo's tone suddenly became profound. On the third page of the Tianji Record, the karma network diagram rotated slowly, finally定格 on a specific node. It was a cluster of palaces floating above the clouds, ancient runes surrounding them, with a towering monument standing in the center—the monument engraved with four large characters: Heavenly Realm Relic."

text.content: "'The second clue points to the Heavenly Realm Relic.' Master Mo's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, 'There lie buried the secrets of the ancient era, and also the answers you seek. But the danger of that place far exceeds your imagination. Every step you take, the Heavenly Dao's gaze grows stronger—sure you want to go?'"

"Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His gaze fell on the dense nodes in the karma network diagram. Among them, one node was particularly conspicuous—it connected the Heavenly Realm Relic to a blurry human silhouette, and that silhouette's outline... was actually somewhat similar to his own. Chen Ji's heart tightened; the Tianji Record seemed to be hinting at something, yet deliberately concealing the key details."

choice.prompt: "Facing the revelation of the Tianji Record's third page and the shortened countdown, Chen Ji must make a choice: cautious action to consolidate his foundation, or take risks to seize time?"

choices.text: "Take the risk and use karma traceback"
choices.description: "Tonight, use karma traceback to investigate the mysterious figure Ye Qing mentioned, seize the initiative."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 30% Heavenly Fate, countdown shortened by one month"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain key intelligence ahead of schedule, seize the initiative"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate plummets, Heavenly Dao backlash intensifies"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingertip pressing on the karma traceback node. Golden light erupted suddenly, his divine sense swept into a vast river of time—countless karma threads intertwined, and the one he sought was flickering within. Yet just then, that icy gaze intensified sharply, as if something had sensed his窥探."

choices.description: "Don't rush to use karma traceback, seal the third page instead, wait for a more suitable moment to deploy this trump card."
choices.visible_cost: "Miss tonight's intelligence window, may miss the initiative"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Heavenly Fate, lower Heavenly Dao's alertness"
choices.risk_hint: "The mysterious person Ye Qing mentioned may act ahead of schedule"

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his finger, slowly closing the Tianji Record. Though karma traceback was powerful, the cost was too heavy; this was not the optimal time for use. He decided to temporarily seal the third page, to weigh things once the situation became clearer. However, the instant he closed the pages, an image burst into his mind unbidden—blurred, distorted, yet clearly indicating some imminent danger."

"In that image, a black shadow was quietly approaching the direction of Tianqing Sect, and where the shadow passed, mountains and rivers changed color, sun and moon lost their light. Chen Ji snapped his eyes open, a fine layer of cold sweat on his forehead. This was not foresight—this was the Tianji Record forcibly warning him! Someone was approaching, and with ill intent."

dialogue.content: "'It seems someone is faster than you thought.' Master Mo's voice carried a hint of gravity, 'That direction... is where Ling Yuan old man's closed-door cultivation was. Did he break through early?'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan! The name was like a basin of ice water poured over his head. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, his mind racing. The old sect master's connection to the Tianji Record ran far deeper than he had ever shown; had the resentment of being skipped over in the inheritance driven him to some unknowable side?"

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan broke through early, seemingly with ill intent—Chen Ji must decide on a response strategy:"

choices.text: "Take the initiative to reveal himself and test the truth"
choices.description: "Rather than wait passively, proactively meet him, using the guise of a废物 to test the old sect master's true intentions."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain key intelligence, judge friend or foe"
choices.risk_hint: "If Ling Yuan already harbors hostility, may fall into danger"

text.content: "Chen Ji straightened his clothes, hid the Tianji Record close to his body, and pushed open the door into the night. His steps were deliberately made unsteady, his posture hunched, the perfect picture of a废材. Yet his divine sense had already spread out, perceiving all movements in the surroundings. In the distance, a faint presence was approaching—that aura was ancient and profound, deep as an abyss, vast as a sea."

choices.description: "Compress all aura completely, find a hidden spot to observe the visitor's movements, gather intelligence before making plans."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss the opportunity to make contact with Ling Yuan"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form flashed, sinking into the shadows beneath the eaves. His aura vanished without a trace, as if he had never existed. A moment later, an elderly figure appeared on the path outside the Servants' Quarters—it was none other than Tianqing Sect's old sect master Ling Yuan. Yet the old man's face now held none of his usual benevolence, only a chilling gloom."

"Ling Yuan's footsteps stopped before Chen Ji's dwelling. His turbid old eyes swept across that closed, shabby wooden door, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. 'This child... hides deep enough.' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached Chen Ji's ears, 'Unfortunately, this old man once walked the same path.'"

"Chen Ji was in the shadows, but his heart sank to the bottom of the valley. The meaning of these words was too obvious—Ling Yuan had long known of his disguise, just never exposed it. Old fox... Chen Ji cursed in his heart, fingers unconsciously tightening around the Tianji Record hidden against his body. Ling Yuan's next words made his pupils constrict even further."

dialogue.content: "'Tianji Record's inheritor... did you think the Eye of Heavenly Dao was unaware?' Ling Yuan's voice was like a wind from the Nine Netherworlds, 'From the day you obtained that thing, you were already being watched. Tonight, this old man comes to give you a warning—or rather, a choice.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's breathing quickened slightly. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—these four characters were like a thunderbolt, cleaving open a corner of his heart he had never dared to touch. So from the very beginning, every step he took had been observed. The Tianji Record was not some heaven-granted fortune, but a carefully designed trap?"

dialogue.content: "Just then, a voice凭空响起, sounding both in Chen Ji's mind and echoing across the entire world. That voice held no emotion, no temperature, only a suffocating冷漠: 'Chen Ji—your chess game should end.'"

choice.prompt: "The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao manifests directly, Chen Ji faces a life-or-death choice:"

choices.text: "Resist with the power of the Tianji Record"
choices.description: "Since the Tianji Record is a piece for the Eye of Heavenly Dao, then let the piece turn against the player—he wants to see how strong this so-called Heavenly Dao Will truly is!"
choices.visible_cost: "May trigger the inevitable backlash, prematurely detonate fate"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji strode abruptly from the shadows, confronting Ling Yuan and that voice in the void. His eyes held no fear, only a near-mad calm. 'Eye of Heavenly Dao?' His voice was hoarse yet clear, 'What a grand title. Unfortunately, I, Chen Ji, have never been a chess piece to be manipulated.' As the words fell, the Tianji Record in his chest thundered loudly, golden light blazing, faintly showing a force to match that Heavenly Dao Will."

choices.text: "Feign weakness and lurk, waiting for the moment"
choices.description: "Exposing all strength now would be utterly foolish—better to continue enduring, waiting for a better counterattack opportunity."
choices.visible_cost: "May suffer further probing from Ling Yuan"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao may intensify pressure further"

text.content: "Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart, re-concealing himself in the shadows. He knew that acting rashly now would only lead to utter destruction. Whether the Eye of Heavenly Dao or Ling Yuan, what he needed was time. As long as the chess game continued, he still had a chance to turn the tables."

choices.text: "Break the situation using the Demonic Path's influence"
choices.description: "The letter left by Ye Qing might be a path—the Demonic Path's opposition to the Eye of Heavenly Dao might be a variable he could exploit."
choices.visible_cost: "The cost of allying with the Demonic Path is unknown"
choices.risk_hint: "May fall into an even greater vortex"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji quietly crushed a corner of the letter left by Ye Qing—a special means of communication. A moment later, demonic energy silently seeped into Tianqing Sect, completing a brief exchange with him. 'Interesting...' Ye Qing's voice rang in his heart, 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao personally intervenes? It seems your value exceeds my imagination. Wait for me—within three days, there will be a response.'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan stood in the night for a long while before finally turning to leave. But before departing, he left words that sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine: 'At the Sect Competition in three days, this old man will personally attend.届时... I hope you will not disappoint me.' Footsteps faded into the distance, until they vanished completely at the end of the night. Only then did Chen Ji slowly exhale a breath of turbid air."

"The Tianji Record trembled once more, and a line of blood-red warning text appeared on the third page—'Time Remaining: Two Months.' At the same time, a blurry image flashed briefly before Chen Ji's eyes: a woman bound by chains, her features seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, beneath her feet carved a massive Heavenly Fate Lock Formation. The image lasted only an instant before dissolving, but the woman's lips seemed to be silently speaking something. Chen Nian... that was Chen Nian! Chen Ji clenched his fist suddenly, his knuckles white from the force. Was the awakening of the Tianji Record's third page giving him hope for a comeback, or pushing him into an even deeper abyss?"
